text_to_speech: welcome to the Laura showcase this time we have a look at Victorian dress by n5g he created a luras for both stable diffusion 1.5 and stable diffusion XL with his Laura you are able to generate Victorian dresses in a wide variety according to him there can be Edwardian and Barac influences in there as well but his goal wasn't to go for a perfect historical accuracy anyway trigger is Victorian dress but you can combine it with other dress adjacent tags like lace lace overlay Ruffles bro bule bodies and so on and so forth a weight range from 0.4 up to 1.0 gave me best results so consider leaving a like and feedback for n5g I leave the link to his civit AI account down in the description

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Welcome to the Laura Showcase. This time we have a look at Victorian dress by N15G.
He created a Laura's for both Stability Fusion 1.5 and Stability Fusion XL.
With his Laura you are able to generate Victorian dresses in a wide variety.
According to him, there can be Edwardian and Barock influences in there as well,
but his goal wasn't to go for a perfect historical accuracy anyway.
Trigger word is Victorian dress, but you can combine it with other dress adjacent tags like
lace, lace overlay, ruffles, brooch, bustle, bodice, and so on and so forth.
A weight range from 0.4 up to 1.0 gave me best results.
So consider leaving a like and feedback for N15G.
I leave the link to his civet AI account down in the description.
